source: The release audit docs/26 V1-REL-01 refers to is the 2026-08-22 21-agent independent audit (workflows wf_162de4d5-f35 + wf_f183ba6f-9c5): 60 P0/P1 claims — 12 skeptic-verified (V01–V12, in the audit's verification order) and 48 unverified (U01–U48, in the audit's listing order) — whose closures are recorded in docs/23-known-limitations.md §D.12–§D.33 and §D.25. The audit's findings file lived outside the tree (session scratch, audit.json); every row below names the claim as the audit phrased it, the skeptic verdict where one exists, and the docs/23 section (or the file) that records the closure.
built: Assembled by hand ONCE on 2026-08-23 from docs/23 §D, the phase-0/phase-1/phase-2 commit messages and the audit's own claim list; verified by `npm run v1:readiness` (V1-REL-01): every closing commit must be on this history, every acceptance command must exit 0, every cited anchor must resolve, and an open-human row must name the RELEASE_CHECKLIST row that owns it. Severities are the audit's; a skeptic re-grade is quoted in the note, never applied to the column.

rows.title: conformance exits 0 with three baselined red rows it labels HARMFUL
rows.note: Not hidden: the gate prints the three UNDECLARED-CARRY rows as HARMFUL by name on every run, BASELINE.json is a decrease-only ratchet, and §B.8 (register item 4) names the constructs — @container, a non-matching @media branch, stage-box-equal. The carriage itself is a limitation, not a closed defect.

rows.title: v1.0.0-rc.1 tag exists on origin (34d92c08, unsigned) while the checklist's 'Signed RC tag approved' row is empty
rows.note: Tag operations are a recorded human approval (V1-REL-02). The owner either signs/retags on the release commit or deletes the premature tag and records the disposition; no automation row can close it.

rows.title: RELEASE_CHECKLIST and AUDIT-LEDGER evidence frozen 172 commits behind HEAD; every [x] automation row is stale
rows.note: The overclaim is gone: every frozen section is labelled STALE with the reason, and the wave10 ledger row points at this generated ledger. The re-freeze itself is a release act (V1-REL-02).

rows.title: ci:lanes fails: the maintain team gate and its checks run in no CI workflow
docs/24 What Works is STALE vs its sources; capability:fresh fails in five requirement rows
Plugin engine bundle STALE vs core at HEAD — plugin:zip, plugin:check, build:playground, plugin:ui-check all fail on the commit
Hosted no-clone plugin zip carries a third engine (3de67ce4 · 716832B) matching neither HEAD's receipt nor the working tree
rows.note: The hosted zip is a deployment; a deployment is a recorded human approval (V1-REL-02) and `npm run deploy:check` is red by construction until it happens. docs/00 offers the hosted zip as the no-clone path without saying which engine it carries — the deploy (or a pinned engine stamp on that page) is the close.

rows.title: Journey A on the golden lane is not reproducible from main: the only Flowbite dump is gitignored
rows.note: extract/figma/fixtures/flowbite-eight.dump.json (+ stamps) is committed; the golden path was re-run on a fresh clone at eight stems (GOLDEN-PATH-RECEIPT.md).

rows.title: docs/24 STALE on main by its own freshness guard; README's '266 generated files' contradicts docs/24 and evals/golden.json (291)
npm run maintain exits 1 in a clean clone: needs FIGMA_TOKEN that BETA.md says you do not need
rows.note: maintain is token-free; the Figma half is maintain:visual (catalog-visual lane, FIGMA_TOKEN secret). The one visual-named maintain step, extract:figma:visual:anchors, is file-only and needs no token. (First receipt run false-redded this row: the original one-liner grepped /visual/ and hit that step's name.)

rows.title: BETA.md pins bundle sha af0a5dee…/108,557 B while every real build is d6da51d6…/109,839 B; golden-path receipt never re-run
rows.note: The committed bundle is byte-identical to two fresh builds; the golden path was re-run on a fresh clone (GOLDEN-PATH-RECEIPT.md, 2026-08-22).

rows.note: The receipt's 'Recorded <date>' line moves only when the body moves (the full lane runs it and fails on a dirtied tree); ToggleSwitch carries both FC-FONT-SUBSTRATE and FC-TOGGLE-THUMB (NORTH-STAR attribution retained, §D.15).

rows.title: canvas-gate-standing-pin (C3-detection) renders nothing — it compares committed 2026-07-20 scorecards to hard-coded numbers
rows.note: The eval is a PIN of committed scorecards and says so in its own claim text ('pinned per component, round-5d final run'); the re-render lives in maintain:visual / catalog-visual, and §C.6.4–C.6.5 name that a headless pin is not a live render.

rows.title: All three CI workflows red on origin/main for the last three pushes; fast-lane gates red locally too
Prune runtime ships in every generated token script with no opt-out; BETA.md flips 'never prunes' to 'prunes' on the strength of a mock
rows.note: Opt-in only (DS_PRUNE_TOKENS); default names leftovers.

rows.title: Hop-4 fixture is a hand-assembled 'compact' dump and the live-extras gate injects invented values that differ from the live file
rows.note: The fixture is a dump of 59mLQlOMiD5w5za6SUcoO5 (extractedAt 2026-08-20, dump v1.30, provenance + degradations carried); the extras pass is pinned as FC-HOP4-LIVE-EXTRAS-SAME-AS-ABSENT — injecting the fields a live pass adds must not grow the mint set, and geometry is never injected (FC-GEOMETRY-EXCLUDED).

rows.title: Exact-projection gate relaxed: verified-exact 45/45 reported while re-emit of the proposed contract draws 40 rows
rows.note: The strict exact gate refuses unrecovered preview cells again (9d65808e); the one relaxation that survived is named FC-PROPOSE-SPARSE-STATE and pinned.

rows.title: npm run typecheck is red: 22 errors (HEAD: 3); 19 introduced by the session

rows.note: FC-DUMP-PROPOSE-CAPTURED-VARIABLES-DROPPED: the dump's _variables land beside minted.dtcg.json as captured.dtcg.json on both the plugin and the REST path.

rows.note: The tree is committed (Phase 0) and the eight contracts carry bindings.figma.anchors to 59mLQ…; the sync-spine lane records every specHash move as a decided row.

rows.title: Default exact projection refuses every committed foreign dump (Untitled UI dumps-v2, Eventz MERGED); the flag that makes them work is undocumented
rows.note: FC-PROPOSE-SPARSE-STATE names the relaxation the foreign dumps need; the exam's REST path runs under --reviewable-inversion by name (FIGMA-DS-EXAM.md §2).

rows.title: Generated React references 176 CSS custom properties that exist in no shipped CSS file; no CLI verb builds one
Part-level host element, aria attrs and events are never stamped on the canvas and never named per part
rows.note: Every canvas-dropped fact is a codeOnlyFact {part, kind, channel, value, reason} in the script, the bundle, the plugin data and the plugin report (§D.16, §D.21).

rows.title: Boolean variant axes are excluded from both correlation routines: Eventz isDisabled opacity and isChecked icon state dropped with a FALSE note
The mock that certifies the engine is permissive exactly where live Figma throws: paints/effects/text props unvalidated, fonts always load
rows.note: The mock carries the REAL-FIGMA VALIDATION sites live runs found (fontSize, grid tracks, CHANGE_TO destinations) and names what it does not validate in its header; the emitted runtime pushes FC-RT-* degradations into the per-set result instead of swallowing (§D.21); §C.6.4 states that headless green is not live correct and the live receipts (LIVE-APPLY-RECEIPT.md, GOLDEN-PATH-RECEIPT.md) are the real-Figma evidence.
